## Summary

What changes and why.

## Related

Issue and decision record this change follows, for example `Closes #12` and `docs/decisions/0002-...md`.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change reuses WordPress settings instead of adding package options, or a decision record explains why not.
- [ ] Tests cover the change, or the description explains why none apply.
- [ ] Documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated when behavior changes.
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits and carry no tool or AI attribution lines.

## How to verify

Commands and steps a reviewer can run.
